title: Raise spec gaps upstream (conditional, object-history, emailpush, blobext, RFC 9404 errata)
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md, emailpush.md, blobext.md, object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md (the 'Upstream list' at its end).
Crates: none. Size: S.

The 2026-11-13 decisions implement spec-gap stopgaps now and raise them with the draft authors. Draft each message or issue text for Mark, quoting the draft text it refers to; Mark files or sends them. Do not send anything.

- object-history-03 (brong/draft-gondwana-jmap-object-history or the jmap list), decision 6:
  (a) restores count toward maxObjectsInSet (RFC 8620 names only create/update/destroy);
  (c) an onlyDestroyed query is identified by its queryState, so Foo/queryChanges routes by it;
  (d) an object whose final version was discarded is gone (notFound for get, query and restore).
- object-history-03 AND conditional-02, decision 6(b): atomic covers restores, and atomicFailure MAY carry notRestored.
- emailpush-05 (jmapio/jmap), decisions 9 and 10: EmailPushConfig filter has no stated default (ask for "(default: null)"); exclude objectHistory from properties as bodyValues is excluded.
- blobext-03 (brong/draft-gondwana-jmap-blobext), decision 15: the eight gap rulings (a)-(h) in docs/design/blobext.md §2 (absent oldState/newState/expires in examples; Blob/convert response shape; Blob/get ids null; Blob/set create cycle; #ref to a failed creation is notFound; null DSO data key counts as absent; offset/length without properties; Blob/convert invalidProperties JSON-pointer paths).
- RFC 9404 (possible errata, RFC Editor errata system or the jmap list), decision 21: (ii) §4.3.1's example returns notFound for an unknown blob, while the §4.3 normative text requires a row with empty arrays and defines no notFound; crate-jmap follows the text. (iii) §4.1 says Blob/upload has "no state field present in the method response" and only create is allowed, with created and notCreated results, while the §4.1.2 and §4.2.2 examples carry oldState/updated/destroyed; crate-jmap emits accountId/created/notCreated only.

Not here: JMAP Tasks. Decision 23 supersedes the Tasks registration ask: Mark writes the updated Tasks draft himself (JMAP-jkl8.9) with the Data Types / Supports History registrations, and there is no WG approach for now (JMAP-tna1.3.23 closed).

The per-draft drafting beads feed this one: JMAP-tna1.3.24 (object-history H22), JMAP-r44n.17 (emailpush E17). Acceptance: every item above has drafted text handed to Mark and is marked offered or filed in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
